title: I Left a Note for the Traffic Cop 🚗
description:
This story may be inspired by real events or jokes, but all names and details are fictional. Any resemblance to real people is coincidental.

#funny #storytime #parking #shorts
style: 3D animated cartoon movie style, expressive characters with big eyes, vibrant colours, cinematic lighting, vertical composition, highly detailed, no text, no letters, no watermark

scenes.text: I was late for the most important job interview of my life, and there was not one parking spot in the entire city.
scenes.image: a stressed young man about 30 in a suit holding car keys driving in circles in a crowded city street, sweating, every spot taken

scenes.text: I circled the block ten times. Finally, I parked in a no parking zone.
scenes.image: a stressed young man about 30 in a suit holding car keys parking under a big no parking sign, nervous

scenes.text: I wrote a note and put it on my windshield. Dear officer, I circled this block ten times. I'm late for a job interview. Please forgive my trespass.
scenes.image: a stressed young man about 30 in a suit holding car keys tucking a handwritten note under a windshield wiper

scenes.text: The interview went amazing. I got the job. I came back smiling.
scenes.image: a stressed young man about 30 in a suit holding car keys walking out of an office building happily, fist pump

scenes.text: And there it was. A parking ticket. With a note of its own.
scenes.image: close-up of a parking ticket and a note under a windshield wiper

scenes.text: It said: I've circled this block for fifteen years. If I don't write tickets, I lose my job.
scenes.image: a stern traffic police officer with a notepad and a cap smirking while writing a ticket, flashback style

scenes.text: Then at the bottom: Congrats on the new job. You'll need it for this ticket.
scenes.image: a stressed young man about 30 in a suit holding car keys reading the note, jaw dropped, then laughing in defeat

scenes.text: Best job interview I ever had. Most expensive one too.
scenes.image: a stressed young man about 30 in a suit holding car keys paying a ticket at a counter, shrugging with a smile
